_readme: This project's own registry of known traps — situations that look safe but aren't, worth telling an agent (or a new teammate) at the start of a session rather than leaving them to be rediscovered the expensive way. Full field contract: plugins/backend-suite/templates/known-traps.schema.json. Delete this whole file (or leave 'entries' empty) if you don't have any yet; every other config file works without it. Populate it the way you'd write a CLAUDE.md 'gotchas' section — each entry is one trap, not a category of traps.

entries.title: TODO: short name for the trap
entries.trigger: TODO: the situation that surfaces it — what you'd be about to do right before walking into it
entries.trap: TODO: what actually goes wrong if you act on the trigger naively
entries.correctAction: TODO: what to do instead, concretely
